title: Safe Revocation Without Complete Diagnosis: Exact Resource Frontiers under Coupled Faults for Subjecthood-Agnostic AI Coexistence
author: Hongju Liu

claims.statement: Finite subjecthood-agnostic revocation with shared diagnostic and bank fault budget
Every observation union must fit capacity in each same compatible world
Smallest-j capacity constraint has minimal total W+(b-j)ceil(W/j)
Exact general coupled-budget minimum and simultaneously attaining balanced allocation
At d=b=f+1, capacity (f+1)k is minimal despite nonunique diagnosis
Specific decoupled worst-case rule requires factor f+1 more capacity in same fixed placement
Arbitrary one-fault maps: R=max(max L_i,ceil(sum L_i/(m-1))) with an attaining nonuniform allocation
Arbitrary repeated class labels and root-fault counts have exact capacity frontier, recovering PR5
Independent worlds, capacity search and direct-action checks match on recorded finite configurations

proof_status: Written lower bounds and attaining constructions; same-workflow critical review, not external peer review
preservation_scope: Full manuscript in three concatenable source parts and build entry, both actual executed scripts, result summary, work log and Chinese handoff in GitHub. Full raw runs, second-run receipts, baseline regression, audits, PDF, metadata draft and hashes in downloadable archive. No Library write asserted.
merge_policy: Disabled entry, no automatic formal-graph merge. Theorems do not depend on unreviewed UCT phenomenal claims.
